title: The Remnant
lead: The Bible's hope that God keeps a small group alive through judgment, and carries his promises on through them: Noah's family, the seven thousand who did not bow to Baal (1 Kings 19:18), Isaiah's son named "A remnant will return" (Isaiah 7:3; Isaiah 10:20–22), the survivors who came back from Babylon (Ezra 9:8–15), and Paul's "remnant chosen by grace" (Romans 11:5).
